requirements.requirement: Accept exact D-02 source/evidence hashes and additive package boundary checker; root baseline checker still freezes only D-01. Update shared manifest/CI only through D-01 review.

Authenticated non-JSON AuthContext source separated from worker process. Load principals, independent QA subjects, membership, policy/auth/stop/owner epochs and current task/spec/fence from authoritative state; no worker-supplied trust registry.

In a serialized durable transaction compare current revision/lease/fence/epochs, enforce scope and action/resource/payload/actor binding, consume one-use approval, reserve exact quote/cap quota and decrement child/ancestor attempts. Unique project/task/operation identity blocks replay across restart.

Before physical dispatch recheck authority at a defined linearization point against concurrent revoke/cancel. Use durable fenced inbox/outbox; dispatching/unknown outcomes retain approval consumption and reservation until reconciliation; never infer safe retry from timeout.

Apply project/task/classification ACL before retrieval, ranking, trace projection or serialization; keep hidden QA outside Executor checkout and local verdict sealed from Examiner/Auditor; independent identities cannot alias producer subject.

Run negative suite against disposable authoritative adapter, including lost lease, stale context, unavailable store, enqueue/retrieval then revoke, concurrent approval/quota use, crash/restart/replay and child parent revoke. Store command/exit/hash and zero unauthorized physical effects.
Approve disposable infrastructure/custodian and execute all 10 sandbox acceptance probes independently; no real keys, provider or live Workspace without separate authorization.
